Attach styles to specific cell locations.

Source: R/html_table.R
ht_tab_style.Rd

Mirrors gt::tab_style(). style is a named character vector of CSS properties (most easily built with ht_cell_text() / ht_cell_fill()), a raw CSS string ("padding-left: 0;"), or a list of any of those. locations is a single ht_cells_*() object or a list of them.

Usage

ht_tab_style(x, style, locations)

Arguments

x

A html_table.

style

A style spec. See description.

locations

One ht_cells_body() / ht_cells_stub() / etc., or a list of them.

Details

rows expressions on body / stub locations are evaluated here against x$data, not deferred to render time. Free variables in the expression (e.g., a loop-local desc) are resolved against the caller's frame at the moment ht_tab_style() runs, so loops like for (desc in ...) out <- ht_tab_style(out, ..., rows = X == desc) behave as written.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ht_table(dat) |>
  ht_tab_style(
    style = ht_cell_text(weight = "bold", color = "red"),
    locations = ht_cells_body(columns = "value", rows = is.na(value))
  )
} # }
